scope:
Matched complete-MSA area fits with actual ALTCLKCTRL falling-edge gating.

Both variants retain all 2690 physical bits and the same registered50MHz shell.
Raw guest enable is available before the falling edge; actual guest advance is
latched at that edge. Controllers/frontends stay on host_clk. No fabric AND
clock, clock-period relaxation, timing exception, assembly or deployment.

manifest.scope:
MSA component with a shared external clock for its 78 physical FF helpers.

The supplied FF clock must pulse on precisely each real guest advance or scan
step. Host memory frontends and the scan controller retain the free-running
storage clock. Every physical field/helper equation and scan address remains.
This exposes a clock contract; native global clock implementation is separate.

frontend_manifest.scope:
Serial access to the selected native storage frontend's physical registers.

The host work continues during guest stalls. Only a final external hold stops
both domains; the caller must first drain accepted raw transactions and hold
all consumers. SDRAM refresh and global service barriers are outside this cell.
The guest advance must be the actual clock gate's pre-edge enable. This pins
the exact frozen native nondeferred source; changing that policy needs a new schema/gate.
frontend_manifest.policy: Exact archived native nondeferred source, not the working-tree deferred-capable variant

manifest.native_transport_integration: PENDING: external FF-clock contract is not integrated in the current4096-cycle twelve-slot transport.

declaration_normalization.scope: Exact inverse of declaration-order-only fabric relocation; no normal logic/pin/state-map edits

manifest.clock_contract: Related storage-clock rising edges only; real guest advances or scans. Other-board scan pulses require this board already held. External gate phase must be captured/reconstructed by a future global barrier.
manifest.limits: Component experiment; no native clock gate/barrier, area/timing, FPGA or speed qualification.
